reviews.author: Geri Girard
reviews.text: These guys were amazing. A piece of metal slashed my tire on 95. I was traveling with my daughter we were moving from Florida to North Carolina. We had 2 cars, 2 dogs and a 7 month old baby. It would not have been safe driving the rest of the way on a donut. They had a brand new tire on and off the rim in thirty minutes. I paid a very reasonable price for the tire no more than I would have paid for my mechanic back in Florida.

reviews.author: Rick Corn
reviews.text: Great place to get your oil change. They do more than oil changes too. Very reasonable prices. Quick and very good service.

reviews.author: Bob Brindley
reviews.text: Picked up a screw in my tire and stopped by in a pouring rain storm. Honestly I could have sat in the car with it running while the tire was plugged. Fast, friendly and affordable!!!! I definitely chose the right tire repair shop today! Thanks Guys!

reviews.author: Pete Renzi
reviews.text: These guys are amazing ! Fast friendly service. We blew out a tire on our boat trailer on our way back from Florida. Put on spare but we’re we’re afraid to continue our our trip without a spare. We showed up Monday morning and they had us in and out in 15minutes. They had the tire we needed. Thanks you for excellent service.

reviews.author: Kasey Shirer
reviews.text: This place is great. I was taking my car to Columbia, which was an hour drive for me both ways. I started coming here and I am never going back to Columbia. This place is literary so fast I don’t have time to relax. They are so nice and always ready to help. I felt like a priority and I have only been 3 times. You don’t even need an appointment, just come on in!

reviews.author: Viola Crutchley
reviews.text: I have been coming here for 11 years. They always do a great job with both my vehicles. They make sure everything is done right especially when they know I'm traveling. They help keep me safe from problems on the road. I am always confident that they've done it right. They even vacuum my floors... it's a pleasant and quick trip in.

reviews.author: Brittany
reviews.text: Love this place! Great customer service and reasonably priced. Thanks Bill for all you do for our community.

reviews.author: Lori Frysinger
reviews.text: Traveling from out of town. Hit a curb, needed a tire and Santee oil and lube was on top of it as soon as they opened their doors. Thank you!

reviews.author: Robert Winters
reviews.text: Absolutely the best oil/lube store in the entire low country. Excellent quality products, fast service and reasonably priced! Very honest, reliable, and transparent I would give them 10 stars if I could. I would never go anywhere else for oil changes on 4 different vehicles!

reviews.author: Tina Hogue
reviews.text: I was traveling home (East Tennessee) from a work conference when I started losing tire pressure in one tire. I was so fortunate to stop here. They discovered a nail in my tire, plugged it and got me back on the road in about 15 minutes. They were incredible and I’m very thankful.

reviews.author: Zach Rogers
reviews.text: This shop was great. Really saved us when we got a flat on I-95. The shop staff and manager were all very helpful and friendly. Andre did a great job and saved us a lot of money and stress, and ultimately saved us from having to buy a whole new tire. That meant a lot during a stressful holiday road trip. Highly recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Jessica Jones
reviews.text: Amazing guys! Went this morning bc I thought my breaks might be going and they checked everything out for me and easily could have told me I needed them done but they were honest and polite and didn't try to rip me off and told me I had some time before I needed the brakes done and tires so I will definitely be going right back to them when I need the work done if I could give them more stars I would! Definitely recommend these guys!!!!

reviews.author: Jason Wood
reviews.text: Fantastic service. We blew a tire on the way home to Toronto and they had us fixed up and on our way in less than 20 mins. Staff were amazing to deal with. Love from Canada!

reviews.author: Tonya Johnson
reviews.text: They the best !! Very professional, they work fast, very respectful guys, always clean inside, never had a bad experience me and my family get our oil changed faithfully for many many years!

reviews.author: Rodney Parker
reviews.text: We're from out of town and had a tire blowout. Tow truck driver recommended them. Took the blown out tire in, and in less than five minutes they had a new tire mounted and ready to go. Everyone was extremely nice, professional, and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Chris Mensing
reviews.text: Ran over a shovel on the interstate which damaged my tire and a piece of trim on my car. Within 2 hours I was back on the interstate with a new tire and the trim in my trunk. They apologized several times for making me wait. I felt I received fantastic service. The people were so nice and polite. Another thing is it was a reasonable price, I needed to get back on the road but they didn't overprice the job.

reviews.author: Joe Flood
reviews.text: Very friendly and knowledgeable staff. Extremely well stocked location with the ability to QUICKLY source any speciality parts. Andre in the tire alignment shop is AWESOME! Extremely fast and efficient crew. Labor prices are EXCELLENT and the work is top notch. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED LOCATION!!!

reviews.author: Heather Joyal
reviews.text: I have been here for an oil change and then for my new tires to be balanced and mounted. This place is great! They are quick and won't have you waiting around. Under an hour for the tires. Thanks so much for your service, I will be back!

reviews.author: Chloé Beauvais
reviews.text: They are truly angels! We were on the road to Florida when a tire start leaking. In and out, we were gone in 10 minutes! Thank you SO much!

reviews.author: Kira Judah
reviews.text: We hit a pipe on 95 and got a flat tire. After putting on the spare and getting to the shop, the mechanics were friendly, helpful, and quick. We were fixed and on the road again in an hour. Absolutely recommend.

reviews.author: Robin &Denis Aldridge
reviews.text: Oil changes are quick and reasonable. Don't take your car there to get it fixed the mechanic just does what he wants without asking first and is very rude to customers. The manager Eric is very friendly and tries to accommodate his customers. Don't expect a quote on repairs you won't get one.

reviews.author: Keith Cline
reviews.text: Great place for quick service. Everyone is helpful and they do a great job. No complaints so far. Price is average for an oil change and they do other work as well. Hours are good and they do their best to get you in and out.

reviews.author: Nic Mayo
reviews.text: I went in this afternoon for an oil change and transmission fluid change and I was super impressed. The politeness and professionalism is 5 star. I was in and out in no time. I even called ahead and got pricing and was never a victim of the traditional “up-selling” that I have grown accustomed to at other “chain” lube shops. Oh...and the price I paid was exactly what I was quoted!

reviews.author: Kristi Prince
reviews.text: I was traveling through Santee and had damage to my vehicle on I- 95. The owner, Bill Berry, could not have been nicer!! He assessed the damage and made adjustments to secure my spoiler, so I could continue on my journey to Virginia! I was so very grateful!!

reviews.author: Doug McKenzie
reviews.text: I called ahead to verify they had a tire that I needed in stock. When I arrived I decided to have my oil changed as well. 10 minutes later, I was driving home with a new tire and fresh oil!!!! I will definitely repeat my business here and I would definitely refer any friend of mine to this establishment.

reviews.author: Dianne Reardon
reviews.text: We pulled up front, greeted by the owner, left the car with him, sat in the waiting room for about 20 minutes, paid and were off again! Great experience

reviews.author: Christine Freeman
reviews.text: I was traveling home to Florida from Pennsylvania and I had a tire go flat. Since I was staying the night, I waited until morning to get assistance. They came quickly, took tire back to their garage and brought it back repaired for me. Very kind and considerate service and cost practically nothing

reviews.author: Carol Ann
reviews.text: My car gave me a message ' check air in tires". This seems to happen when it rains but I went to the tire place behind the auto garage. Devon ( I might not have spelled it correct) checked all tires and said the front passenger side tire was down more than others. He checked it completely and found a thin nail in it! Then plugged it but didn't charge me. Great customer service Just had to share this positive story, especially today. With Customer sevice like this, I will return there.

reviews.author: melissa heape
reviews.text: Stopped by in a panic because all 4 tires needed air after running through a rain storm. Staff was so helpful and explained how they all lost pressure at the same time due to extreme temperature change and fixed me right up. Very friendly and quick!

reviews.author: Aron Flavin
reviews.text: Great, friendly and fast service. Thank you to all who work there. I did not catch anyone name, except for Ray, who was quick, kind, and professional.

reviews.author: Kimberly Hogan
reviews.text: I had an oil leak in my car after getting an oil change at Jiffy Lube the day before driving to Florida. I pulled over to this Quick Lube in Santee, where they promptly diagnosed the leak, replaced all of the oil, and power-washed the underside of my car. I was in and out within 30 minutes and back on the highway. Incredible service and an absolutely generous price, no overcharging.

reviews.author: Tyler Martin
reviews.text: Man stopped what he was doing and had my tire plugged in about 3 minutes for a very fair price. Great place glad i got my flat near here

reviews.author: jean ernst
reviews.text: I’ve been so impressed when doing business with them. They are always professional and provide great customer service. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Sandra Nelson Lawson
reviews.text: Meant the owner the pervious week. I had an issue at the car wash but he took care of it.quickly. I doubt he remembered me but when I walked in he asked what did I need. I told him. He got my sister's vehicle and took care of the problem in a quick enough fashion and I was charged.

reviews.author: Lori Gonsiewski
reviews.text: We were driving on I-95 S heading to our vacation destination when one of our RV tires went flat. All of the workers at Santee Quick Lube were super friendly and helpful. Many thanks to Andre for getting us safely back on the road!

reviews.author: Michelle Thomas
reviews.text: Shredded a trailer tire on 95 heading to florida. Found a safe place to pull in and called them for help. They were awesome, very friendly, changed flat, checked air in all the other tires. Can't say enough good things about them.

reviews.author: Donzella Hendrix
reviews.text: The Owner and Staff are phenomenal!!! Customer Service is off the chain. I've been doing business there for years. They are perfect Gentlemen, all of them, professional and highly skilled individuals.

reviews.author: Lynda Pooser
reviews.text: Very polite staff. And very fast. Would tell anyone that this is nice place to go. Have a place for you to set while you wait until they are finished. Awesome

reviews.author: Joesph Kozdra
reviews.text: Absolutely love this place brought my car in done prefect in 10 min very nice people working there. Will always bring my vehicles here ..

reviews.author: Jenifer Foss
reviews.text: Amazing customer service!!!!!! Helped us out big time! Very professional! Quality work! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Rachael Hood
reviews.text: Always quick and quality service and even a vacuumed car. From an oil change, tire plug, wheel balance, they get it done and quick. Such a delight.

reviews.author: Marianne Smitb
reviews.text: I’m and out in 15 minutes. Friendly and reliable. Had a tire plugged and we are back on the road. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Chermeka Keitt
reviews.text: I always feel special when I come here they greet me, serve me, and send me on my way in good spirits and quick service. Bill and his crew do their job like top tier pros!!!

reviews.author: Crystal Maxwell
reviews.text: Very fast and friendly service. When I'm in the area and need my oil change. I always stop here. Thanks for the great service guys!

reviews.author: Troy Pringle
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Great owner, great employees!! Had a flat tire New Year Eve and was in and out in under 30 minutes.

reviews.author: Dianne M
reviews.text: I pulled in with a nail in my tire and 15 minutes later I am out the door. These guys are fantastic.

reviews.author: Angela Torres
reviews.text: Great guy helped us out and promptly changed all the tires on our travel trailer. Feel much safer after we had a blow out the day before.

reviews.author: C Golliday
reviews.text: Do not bother making an appointment. Took 4+ hours for 4 new tires, valve stem TPMS replacement and front end alignment with an appointment. One of my chrome rims was very badly bent during installation of the new tire. I was told the rubber tips was missing from one of their tire machines so they were down to 1 machine which was why it was taking so long. Wish I had checked the rims before I pulled off. The TPMS was installed but not trained to the computer nor the matching silver dust caps installed or to be found. The 3rd row seat belt holder was busted when they threw in the spare tire instead of returning it to the proper place underneath which also left black marks and scraps on interior of my 4x4 SUV. So much for the 4 wheel alignment requested with my 4 new tire installment. They decided to charge me for a front end and it pulled to the right driving out of the parking lot. When I asked bout the TPMS fault warning message that was on while getting into my truck at the shop just before their closing time I was told to go home and disconnect the battery terminals to reset the computer?! Don't bother calling them. They don't listen, focus or care about what your saying. How does this place stay in business? First and last time I travel to Santee for this type of service. Taking my SUV here cost me in addition to their charges a chrome rim, silver valve stem caps, TPMS reset tool, realignment, repair to the damaged interior not to mention my time.

reviews.author: Sabrina Hughes
reviews.text: Needed last minute fix to under carriage of car. Staff was kind and serviced the car quickly. We were back on the road within 15 minutes!

reviews.author: Pastor Arthur Jenkins
reviews.text: They were finished in approximately 10 minutes or less. I was extremely impressed! I'll be going there again if I need their services.

reviews.author: Kylie Miller
reviews.text: Was on a road trip heading home when one of my tires began to separate. Googled local tire shop and this was the highest rated place in Santee. They had the tire size I needed to get me out the door and back on the road!

reviews.author: Wipp Halo
reviews.text: If this is the same guy who owns the car wash machines beware because he's not accountable for anything that goes wrong . 10 dollars in his car wash cost me over 300.00 in clear coat damage

reviews.author: Brittany Cornell
reviews.text: Please update the time of closing on the Google listing. It’s ridiculous to come anywhere to have a service done just to be turned away because the employees want to go home at 5 but everyday closing time is listed online for 5:30.

reviews.author: Michelle Decker
reviews.text: So professional. They vacuum your car with a full service. Will never take any of my 4 vehicles anywhere else

reviews.author: Tammy Trauernicht
reviews.text: Was fast,curtious,and economical. They always check all my fluids and vacumn my vehicle. Always go back to them.

reviews.author: DarK Toad One
reviews.text: Been going there for years, I use only AMSOIL oil and you can't buy it there so I mail order and go there to have it put in.

reviews.author: Lauren Elizabeth (IrresistaBulls)
reviews.text: I could not believe how fast these guys did an oil change. That’s what I’m talking about!!! Keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Paul Bentley
reviews.text: Car wash sucked my F250 extended cab was to long. Paid $8.00 for a wash it made 1 pass down driver side and stopped.

reviews.author: Martin Jones
reviews.text: Wasn't too impressed with the service. I told them I needed an oil change. All they did was change oil and filter. Didn't offer to check other fluids.
